content: {"episode_id":"ep-05146","cpt":"93229","denial_carc":"CO-50","necessity_paragraph":"We appeal the CO-50 determination that CPT 93229, Mobile Cardiac Telemetry monitoring, was not medically necessary. The clinical indication note documents that the patient presents with intermittent palpitations and a known history of atherosclerotic heart disease of the native coronary artery, consistent with the submitted diagnosis codes I25.10 and R00.2. Mobile cardiac telemetry was ordered to correlate these symptomatic episodes with underlying arrhythmias and assess for ischemic changes in the context of established coronary artery disease. We request reconsideration of the CO-50 adjustment for this encounter based on this documented indication."}
